2026-10-29 (zumiez page run): status changed from off_category to verified. The earlier off_category was category-specific (no jeans); the store is live and sells men's T-shirts (homepage title 'Billabong: Surf, Swim & Lifestyle Clothing', nav Men's > T-Shirts & Tanks). known_for from that title.

Shipping page: 'Free Ground Shipping for all orders over $125 and Flat-Rate shipping on all other orders for the contiguous US' (Standard 5–7 business days $10.00 under $125); Hawaii/Alaska $25.00; Canada Economy $58.00 CAD; no P.O. boxes or APO/FPO; wetsuits excluded from free shipping.

Refund policy: '30 day Return Period' from the original ship date (45 days for orders placed Nov 18–Dec 25); '$7.50 restocking fee applied to all returns & exchanges'; online orders can't be returned at retail/outlet stores; exchanges and prepaid labels for US customers only.

Wikipedia (Billabong_(clothing)): founded November 6, 1973 in Gold Coast, Queensland by Gordon and Rena Merchant; HQ Burleigh Heads, Queensland; parent Boardriders, which Authentic Brands Group bought (finalized September 2023).
